recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Future changes to procedure-progressStatus or its terminology should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack; a dedicated detailed surgical progress profile should only be added if Patient Care creates and scopes that profile as a current build artifact.
issue_request: FHIR-7121 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care change request saying Procedure.status was too coarse for detailed surgical workflow states such as in OR, prepped, anesthesia induced, opened, closed, and recovery. The accepted resolution kept Procedure as a high-level resource, created a common extension for detailed procedure progress statuses, and noted that any detailed progress profile would be scheduled outside DSTU2.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-7121 was found. Historical source shows the application path: daa5d326d1 added source/procedure/valueset-procedure-progress-status-codes.xml in 2015; 33b409a4b6 reworked the source and added source/procedure/structuredefinition-extension-procedure-progressStatus.xml with Procedure context and value-set binding; FHIR-12706/25942dbc17 later cleaned the codes; and dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from core R5 source as part of moving extensions out of core.
additional_context: The current core build includes Procedure through source/fhir.ini, and Procedure.status remains a required high-level event status rather than a detailed surgical workflow element. The detailed progress artifacts now live in the FHIR Extension Pack, whose input/extensions-ig.xml includes input/definitions/* as resource input. That Extension Pack source contains StructureDefinition/procedure-progressStatus with context Procedure, the matching value set, and the code system with in-operating-room, prepared, anesthesia-induced, open-incision, closed-incision, and in-recovery-room codes. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-7121 found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Reintroducing the extension into core or adding redundant Procedure prose would be inappropriate because the current core Procedure source remains consistent with the issue's 80% high-level-status rationale and the detailed-status extension is already active in the Extension Pack source.

related_jiras.note: Later Published QA cleanup changed the procedure progress status codes, displays, and definitions; the current Extension Pack terminology reflects that cleanup, so it was used as context but not separately decided.
